premises: Serrated flow in CoCrFeMnNi is linked to dynamic strain aging via Cottrell atmospheres
Dynamic strain aging requires mobile solutes and moving dislocations within specific temperature/strain-rate windows
Removing Co from CoCrFeMnNi does not eliminate the solute species (Mn, Cr, Ni) responsible for dynamic strain aging
